1 · Intro

When to use it.

Reusing a position looks faster, but old data on it causes send-backs and flows into requisitions and hires. Use this to decide between a new position and an update.

Use this whenYou're about to post or change a role and aren't sure whether to create or update a position.

HCM Academy job aid · Position Management

When to create a new position vs. update an existing position

Use when: You're about to post or change a role and aren't sure whether to create or update a position. · System: Overview

  1. Create a new position for a new role.
  2. Create a new one instead of reactivating an inactive position.
  3. Create a new one instead of repurposing a vacant position for a different worker type.
  4. Create a new one when the business unit changes.
  5. Update the position when the same role changes.
  6. Fix the position before any requisition.

Watch-outs

  • Unsure? Ask your engagement consultant before you build anything.
